messages:
Maya Chen: kicking off a CRON dry run for the new dedupe + healthscore recalibration on Orbit cohort. will run in staging first. seeking owners for monitoring and rollback.
Jorge Alvarez: I can watch metrics. which tables/ids?
Maya Chen: primary target is accounts_2024, matching on email+org_id, then fuzzy name match. params: `min_match_score=0.82`, `max_merge_age=90d`.
Priya Singh: FYI this cohort contains ~1.2k trials that are near renewal. small risk if we over-merge.
Lina Park: we should gate by healthscore delta > 0.15 before any automated owner reassignment.
Maya Chen: Agreed. plan is: dry-run -> sample merge file -> handoff to CS for review -> enable auto-merge with gating.
Evan Brooks: What about playbook triggers? if we change owner, we should debounce playbooks for 7 days.
Maya Chen: yes, playbook debounce set to 7d. will add an opt-out tag so enablement flows don't retrigger.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll upload a sample CSV to s3: s3://redwood-staging/sweeps/orbit/dryrun-1758483021.csv
playbook-bot: queued sweep job `orbit-dedupe-v3` (dry-run). Estimated affected rows: 1,237. ETA: 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
analytics-bot: baseline metrics snapshot saved: metrics/sweeps/orbit/1758483021. healthscore mean: 0.61, renewal_risk_pct: 12.3%
Priya Singh: Can we add a check that no customer with active enterprise contract is auto-merged? need `contract_tier != 'enterprise'` in filters.
Maya Chen: good catch, adding filter. updated config:
```
filters:
  - source: accounts_2024
  - condition: email IS NOT NULL
  - condition: contract_tier != 'enterprise'
  - fuzzy_threshold: 0.82
actions:
  - mode: dry_run
  - owner_reassign: false
  - playbook_debounce: 7d
```
Lina Park: run the dry-run, 👀 on the sample list. Priya + Jorge will do manual review, I'll QA gating logic.
Evan Brooks: I'll prep a rollback playbook in case owner mappings are off. template: `reassign-back-to-prev-owner`.
Maya Chen: kicking it now. will post sample and summary when complete. thanks all :thumbsup:
